properties.description: Class test that a composed reply holds its budget: a hub pinning ten exports of 151 nodes each (each member a cut-off cluster under its pair with the hub), composed with one, two and every pinned design at the default budget and at 12,000, 6,000 and 60,000, and the one-other-design call with budget_chars 12,000 and 6,000: the compact reply is at most the budget, every count survives, a reply that fits is untouched, one that does not says so; a finding whose ids were cut keeps affected_ids_total and the reply names what it withheld.
properties.name: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_composed_reply_holds_its_budget.rs
